'''Intelligence Post Drazaal''' was an outpost established by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Intelligence Post Drazaal appears as part of the Duros Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
